_comment: claude CLI settings for the broker runner (run_broker.py passes --settings with this file). Two hooks run broker_guard.py (plan §11.3). PreToolUse with matcher .* sends every tool call to the guard. The guard allows only the calls that §11.3 lists, and it denies with exit code 2. PostToolUse on review_equity_order records the review (review_ok). onFailure block makes a hook that cannot start, crashes, exits 1, or times out block the call. It needs Claude Code 2.1.295 or later.
